images.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: photographic background for a compact Riparim workshop partner card on a website, usable on desktop and mobile. Create one standalone landscape image, 3:2 aspect ratio, approximately 1536x1024. Palette: charcoal, cool graphite, desaturated petrol green details, silver metal; natural restrained color grading, no neon. Composition: a medium-wide scene with the meaningful subject concentrated toward the center-right; calm darker uncluttered negative space in upper-left and lower-left for separate website text. Important subject remains recognizable under central cropping. Soft directional daylight and subtle workshop lighting; rich but readable shadows, convincing materials and geometry. No people, no faces, no visible logos, no car brand badges, no number plates, no written text, no typography, no watermarks. This is a generic symbolic workshop scene, not an actual business profile or a fabricated branded garage. Do not draw a UI, card, border or overlay. Scene: a tidy, believable professional maintenance bay. Subject: an unbranded modern dark silver passenger car safely raised on a robust two-post vehicle lift, seen at three-quarter rear angle with one rear wheel and underbody visible. A modest tool trolley and carefully organized tools in the background. Clean concrete floor, authentic working garage, no exaggerated luxury showroom. Natural 35mm-camera perspective. The car, lift and workshop must be mechanically plausible.
